notes.title: Merge Marbles Visual Overhaul/Halloween Update
notes.content:
Within the next few weeks this update aims to completely overhaul Merge Marbles' art style hoping to give the game more of an identity. A new Halloween marble skin will also be available in the shop! 

There are a few smaller updates to gameplay including:
- A new progress bar in game that shows how close to earning each star you are making it easier to achieve highscores and coins for the shop
- Bombs now reduce marbles to previous tier instead of entirely destroying them as this made bombs very frustrating and felt more punishing than fun
- Controller sensitivity options added

More features may be changed/added but they willl be in the changelog once the update is released!

Also I'd like to give a quick thank you to everyone who has supported this games development!

notes.content:

- Gamepad cursor now available allowing for controllers to use all in game menus
- Some UI elements changed to allow for easier gamepad navigation

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
- Dropping the marble changed to on click/touch screen released to help with touchscreen users (steamdeck)
- Adjusted scores in classic mode to feel more balanced
- Fixed "New best time" always showing in Rock Blast mode
- Removed graphics options and set defaults to be better optimised on older computers
- Removed hills background in favour of a more simple background leading to better performance
